# Nishant Sharma

> Nishant (Nish) Sharma is an Edinburgh-based entrepreneur: founder and CEO of Rutland Square Spirits (chai-spiced Scottish gin and rum, founded in Edinburgh in 2021), founder of Rosslyn Distillery, and founding partner of SPIRITUS Capital. Born in Dibrugarh, Assam, India; moved to Scotland in 2007.
